preterite_tense.overview: El Pretérito Indefinido (Pasado Simple) expresa acciones completadas en el pasado, con principio y fin definidos. Se organiza en grupos según su patrón de irregularidad.

grupo_completamente_irregulares.name: Grupo 1: Verbos totalmente irregulares (casos individuales)
grupo_completamente_irregulares.description: These verbs don't follow any predictable pattern and must be memorized individually

verbs.note: Uses -ER/-IR endings despite being an -AR verb, and without accents
IDENTICAL to IR in preterite; context determines meaning
IDENTICAL to SER in preterite; context determines meaning

example_sentences.spanish: Patty no me dió una respuesta.
example_sentences.english: Patty didn't give me an answer.

example_sentences.spanish: El guía fue a la fiesta con su esposa.
example_sentences.english: The guide went to the party with his wife. (ir)

example_sentences.spanish: Yo fui una buena estudiante en la clase de francés.
example_sentences.english: I was a good student in French class.

example_sentences.spanish: Anoche fui a la casa de mi amiga Cheryl.
example_sentences.english: Last night I went to my friend Cheryl's house.

grupo_2_clave_irregular.name: Grupo 2: Verbos irregulares con clave (stem-changing consonant group)
grupo_2_clave_irregular.description: These verbs change their stem consonant (clave) and share a common set of endings: -e, -iste, -o, -imos, -ieron/-eron

example_sentences.spanish: Ella no quiso ir a la fiesta.
example_sentences.english: She refused to go to the party.
example_sentences.note: Preterite of querer often means 'refused' in negative

example_sentences.spanish: Peter hizo muy bien la tarea de español y ganó una estrella de oro.
example_sentences.english: Peter did the Spanish homework very well and won a gold star.

example_sentences.spanish: Él no quiso venir con nosotros.
example_sentences.english: He refused to come with us.

grupo_3_estar_tener_poder.name: Grupo 3: Verbos con raíz irregular (UV stem group)
grupo_3_estar_tener_poder.description: These verbs use a UV-based irregular stem

verbs.example: Yo estuve feliz en ese momento.
verbs.example_english: I was happy in that moment.

example_sentences.spanish: Yo no estuve caminando porque estaba lloviendo.
example_sentences.english: I wasn't walking because it was raining.

example_sentences.spanish: estuvo en la sala de estar.
example_sentences.english: he/she was in the living room.

additional_practice_sentences.spanish: Anoche estaba caminando y me caí en el camino.
additional_practice_sentences.english: Last night I was walking and I fell on the road.
additional_practice_sentences.note: Imperfect (estaba caminando) sets background; preterite (caí) marks the event

additional_practice_sentences.spanish: En la noche estuve muy cansado, él corría por todos lados.
additional_practice_sentences.english: At night I was very tired, he was running everywhere.
we decided to go to bed early.
